hebrewText: וְ/עַמִּ֥/י תְלוּאִ֖ים לִ/מְשֽׁוּבָתִ֑/י וְ/אֶל עַל֙ יִקְרָאֻ֔/הוּ יַ֖חַד לֹ֥א יְרוֹמֵם

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.explanation: am — povo, nação, grupo de pessoas com identidade comum

tokens.bdb: to suspend; figuratively (through hesitation) to be uncertain; by implication (of mental dependence) to habituate
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to suspend; figuratively  to be uncertain; by implication  to habituate
tokens.enLiteralWord: to suspend; figuratively  to be uncertain; by implication  to habituate
tokens.explanation: to suspend; figuratively  to be uncertain; by implication  to habituate
tokens.explanationEn: to suspend; figuratively  to be uncertain; by implication  to habituate

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: properly, the top; specifically, the highest (i.e. God); also (adverb) aloft, to Jehovah
to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: bewray (self), that are bidden, call (for, forth, self, upon), cry (unto), (be) famous, guest, invite, mention, (give) name, preach, (make) proclaim(-ation), pronounce, publish, read, renowned, say.
tokens.explanation: qara — chamar, nomear, convocar, proclamar, invocar

tokens.kjv: alike, at all (once), both, likewise, only, (al-) together, withal.

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.bdb: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: bring up, exalt (self), extol, give, go up, haughty, heave (up), (be, lift up on, make on, set up on, too) high(-er, one), hold up, levy, lift(-er) up, (be) lofty, ([idiom] a-) loud, mount up, offer (up), [phrase] presumptuously, (be) promote(-ion), proud, set up, tall(-er), take (away, off, up), breed worms.
